A list indexed by a / division, which may be a fraction (the studio's own)
Two vectors multiplied where a number is wanted, or taken % each other, as LSL's dot and cross products (the studio's own)
A call that makes the script sleep, where a Fast one does the same without (the studio's own)

[DESCRIPTION]
In a .luaurc: [NAME]

--!strict -- Every kind of token, to preview the colors local count: number = 0 local name = "Avatar\n"
local function half(n: number): number return n / 2 end
LLEvents.touch_start = function(detected) ll.Say(PUBLIC_CHANNEL, `Hello {name}`) for i = 1, #detected do count += 1 end if count > 3 then LLTimers:once(half(count), function() ll.OwnerSay(tostring(math.pi)) end) end end

combo_box.name: theme
combo_box.tool_tip: A set of colors for the editor. Custom uses the colors set in the swatches

button.label: Save As...
button.name: save_theme
button.tool_tip: Save the current colors as your own theme

button.label: Skin Colors
button.name: restore_skin
button.tool_tip: Reset every color to the skin's colors

font_field.name: font
font_field.tool_tip: The editor font, shown in itself. Click to choose the face, size and style, with a sample

code_editor.name: preview
code_editor.tool_tip: How the editor will look. You can type here; nothing is saved

panel.label: Editor
panel.name: editor_tab

spinner.name: tab_width
spinner.tool_tip: Columns between tab stops, and the width of one indentation level

check_box.label: Indent with spaces rather than tabs
check_box.name: insert_spaces
check_box.tool_tip: On, Tab, new lines and the formatter use spaces; off, tabs. For scripts with undetected indentation.

check_box.label: Indent each script as it is already indented
check_box.name: detect_indentation
check_box.tool_tip: Reads each script's tabs or spaces and indent width on open. The status bar shows and changes it.

check_box.label: Indent pasted lines to where they go
check_box.name: reindent_on_paste
check_box.tool_tip: Pasted lines take the indentation where they land, keeping relative indents. One Undo restores them.

check_box.label: Close brackets and quotes as they are typed
check_box.name: auto_close
check_box.tool_tip: An opening bracket or quote adds its closer, or wraps a selection. Backspace deletes an empty pair

check_box.label: Suggest completions as a name is typed
check_box.name: auto_complete
check_box.tool_tip: The completion list opens as you type; off, only when you press Control-Space

spinner.name: complete_after
spinner.tool_tip: How many letters of a name to type before the completion list opens

check_box.label: Return accepts the selected completion (Tab always does)
check_box.name: accept_on_enter
check_box.tool_tip: Off, Return starts a new line and closes the list; only Tab accepts a completion

panel.text: Blank lines kept in a row:

spinner.name: blank_lines
spinner.tool_tip: The most blank lines in a row that formatting keeps; extra ones are removed

check_box.label: Set the spaces within lines, not only the indentation
check_box.name: format_spacing
check_box.tool_tip: Formatting puts one space around operators and after commas; off, it only fixes indentation

check_box.label: Reopen the last session's tabs
check_box.name: restore_tabs
check_box.tool_tip: Reopen last session's tabs when the window opens; off, open only what you asked for

combo_box.name: caret_style
combo_box.tool_tip: How the caret is drawn. Vim normal mode always draws a block

check_box.label: Blink
check_box.name: caret_blink
check_box.tool_tip: Off, the caret stays solid

check_box.label: Show what a name or a problem is when the mouse rests on it
check_box.name: hover_cards
check_box.tool_tip: A card with the declaration, its documentation and any problem there

spinner.name: hover_delay
spinner.tool_tip: How long the mouse rests on a name before its card shows

check_box.label: Yank, delete and put use the system clipboard
check_box.name: vim_clipboard
check_box.tool_tip: y, d, x and p with no register use the system clipboard (clipboard=unnamed). Off, only "+ and "* do.

line_editor.label: Drop a notecard here
line_editor.name: vimrc_notecard
line_editor.tool_tip: Drop an inventory notecard here to use as your vimrc wherever you log in. Cached until it changes

button.label: Edit
button.name: vimrc_edit
button.tool_tip: Open the vimrc in Script Studio: the notecard, or else the file (created if missing)

button.label: Clear
button.name: vimrc_clear
button.tool_tip: Stop using the notecard and read the vimrc file in the settings folder again

panel.label: Build
panel.name: build_tab

check_box.label: Hold a save when the checkers find errors
check_box.name: preflight
check_box.tool_tip: On, checker errors hold a save until you save again. Off, it saves and reports the error count

check_box.label: Make safe fixes when saving
check_box.name: fix_on_save
check_box.tool_tip: Before saving, applies fixes that do not change behavior, as one undo step. Removes nothing

check_box.label: Format scripts when saving
check_box.name: format_on_save
check_box.tool_tip: Formats the whole script before saving, as one undo step

check_box.label: Trim trailing spaces when saving
check_box.name: trim_on_save
check_box.tool_tip: Removes spaces and tabs at the ends of lines before saving, as one undo step

line_editor.name: external_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: Command for Edit in External Editor: the program, then "%s" for the file. Empty: system editor

button.label: Browse...
button.name: external_browse
button.tool_tip: Choose the program to build the command from

button.label: More Scripting Settings...
button.name: scripting_settings
button.tool_tip: Opens the viewer's scripting settings: VS Code integration and WebSocket sync

check_box.label: Include from the object and your inventory
check_box.name: preproc_world
check_box.tool_tip: #include and require may use items in the script's object or your inventory; off, only disk folders

check_box.label: Include files from folders on disk
check_box.name: preproc_disk
check_box.tool_tip: #include (--#include in SLua) and require may read files in the folders below; off, nothing on disk

pane_list.name: include_folders
pane_list.tool_tip: Folders searched for includes, top first

panel.text: Include search order, first to last:

scroll_list.name: include_order
scroll_list.tool_tip: Include search order, first match wins; unticked places are skipped

check_box.label: Preprocess every script when saving
check_box.name: preproc_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Preprocess all scripts on save, keeping the source in Firestorm's envelope. Off: only enveloped ones

check_box.label: Switch statements
check_box.name: preproc_switch
check_box.tool_tip: Adds a switch statement to LSL, converted to jumps before compiling

check_box.label: Lazy lists
check_box.name: preproc_lazy
check_box.tool_tip: Lets LSL read a list element with list[i], as Firestorm's preprocessor allows

check_box.label: Break, continue, &= |= ^= and inline
check_box.name: preproc_extensions
check_box.tool_tip: Adds break, continue, &= |= ^= <<= >>= and inline functions to LSL, converted before compiling

check_box.label: Compress the preprocessed code
check_box.name: preproc_compress
check_box.tool_tip: Removes comments and extra spaces from the preprocessed code, for a smaller asset

check_box.label: Optimize LSL: fold constants, drop unused code
check_box.name: preproc_optimize
check_box.tool_tip: Folds constants, removes unused code, lists each change in Problems. Math follows the compile target

check_box.label: Shrink names
check_box.name: preproc_shrink
check_box.tool_tip: Shortens global names in the preprocessed code; your source keeps the real names

check_box.label: Join string constants
check_box.name: preproc_addstrings
check_box.tool_tip: Joins adjacent string constants into one, which LSL does not do itself

check_box.label: Inline functions called once
check_box.name: preproc_inline
check_box.tool_tip: Replaces a function called from only one place with its body, and removes the function

panel.text: Macros for every script, one per line (NAME or NAME=value):

text_editor.name: preproc_defines
text_editor.tool_tip: Macros defined before every script: DEBUG is 1, VERSION=2 is 2. A script's #define or #undef wins

panel.label: Lints
panel.name: lints_tab

scroll_list.name: lints_lsl
scroll_list.tool_tip: Warnings from the LSL checker. On reports one; Error counts it as an error, which can hold a save

button.label: Defaults
button.name: lints_defaults
button.tool_tip: Every lint on as a warning; SLua checked nonstrict by the old type solver, as the grid compiles

combo_box.name: luau_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Where no --! comment or .luaurc sets it. Solver's default: old solver nonstrict, new strict

combo_box.name: luau_solver
combo_box.tool_tip: Luau type solver for SLua. Old is the grid's; New finds different mistakes, may be slower; some messages English only

scroll_list.name: lints_luau
scroll_list.tool_tip: Lint rules for SLua. On reports one; Error counts it as an error, which can hold a save

panel.text: A .luaurc next to a script overrides these for that script: each lint and the type checking mode.

panel.label: Snippets
panel.name: snippets_tab

scroll_list.name: snippet_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Your snippets, then the viewer's built-in ones (copy one to change it). Drop a snippets notecard here to add its snippets to yours.

button.label: Copy
button.name: snippet_copy
button.tool_tip: Copy the selected snippet, built-in or yours, into your snippets to change it

button.label: Delete
button.name: snippet_delete
button.tool_tip: Delete the selected snippet (your own only)

button.label: Save to Inventory
button.name: snippet_to_inventory
button.tool_tip: Save your own snippets, LSL and SLua, to a new notecard in your Notecards folder, to keep or to give. Dropping that notecard here adds its snippets.

line_editor.name: snippet_name
line_editor.tool_tip: The name shown in the Insert menu and the completion list

line_editor.name: snippet_prefix
line_editor.tool_tip: What to type for completion to offer this snippet

line_editor.name: snippet_detail
line_editor.tool_tip: A short description shown beside the name

panel.text: ${1:text}, ${2} and $1 are Tab stops, in order; $0 is where the caret ends.

button.label: Edit as XML...
button.name: snippet_xml
button.tool_tip: Open your snippets file as XML in Script Studio

panel.label: Templates
panel.name: templates_tab
panel.text: The text a new script made in the Explorer starts with. If empty, the grid's default.

code_editor.name: template_lsl
code_editor.tool_tip: The text a new LSL script starts with; if empty, the grid's default

code_editor.name: template_slua
code_editor.tool_tip: The text a new SLua script starts with; if empty, the grid's default

panel.label: LSL to SLua
panel.name: convert_tab
panel.text: How Code > Convert to SLua writes an LSL script. Each choice changes only what means exactly what the LSL did; what it leaves as LSL had it is noted, with SLua's way.

combo_box.name: convert_preset
combo_box.tool_tip: SLua's own ways, as far as each means what the LSL did; or as close to LSL as SLua lets it be, with llcompat and the timer event

combo_box.item.label: As close to LSL as it can be
combo_box.item.name: convert_close

check_box.label: Timers on LLTimers
check_box.name: convert_timers
check_box.tool_tip: llSetTimerEvent's timer runs on LLTimers, calling the timer handler of the state the script is in. Off: the timer event, set going by llcompat.SetTimerEvent.

check_box.label: What was detected from the handler's table
check_box.name: convert_detected
check_box.tool_tip: llDetectedKey(0) in a touch_start becomes detected[1]:getKey(). Off: llcompat.DetectedKey(0).

check_box.label: SLua's ll where it means the same as llcompat
check_box.name: convert_calls
check_box.tool_tip: A boolean answer (if ll.SameGroup(id) then), a constant index moved on by one, and a find asked only whether it found, read against nil. Off: llcompat for all of them.

check_box.label: What SLua has in a call's stead
check_box.name: convert_idioms
check_box.tool_tip: math, vector and quaternion's functions, ^, print, os.time and table.find, where they mean the same as the LSL call.

check_box.label: Handlers assigned to LLEvents' fields
check_box.name: convert_fields
check_box.tool_tip: LLEvents.touch_start = function(detected) ... end, one for each event. Off: LLEvents:on, which lets other code listen to the event too.

check_box.label: Luau types on locals, parameters and returns
check_box.name: convert_types
check_box.tool_tip: local count: number = 0, and function names(who: string): string, from LSL's types.

check_box.label: A -- LSL: comment over each place the two languages differ
check_box.name: convert_comments
check_box.tool_tip: Each place SLua means something else than LSL did, or has a way of its own, said over its line. Off: said only in Output.

button.label: Cancel
button.name: cancel
button.tool_tip: Restore every color and setting to how it was when this window opened
